(2) 'never the older chain' can't be enforced in the plain body when the inbound itself carries a quoted chain, since the server quotes the whole message and the prompt forbids touching it; not triggered here (single-line inbound). (3) The read-back as written checks thread and recipients, not quote count; 'exactly one quote per body' rests on 'never paste one there' plus the 'if html_body has none' condition. If the draft update that adds the html quote made the server re-append its plain quote, nothing in the read-back would catch a double.
